pullRequests.title: feat(include): qcopy_nc() and qzero(), and the 17 functions they unlock (51.63% to 53.10%)
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: main
pullRequests.body:
Summary
Two small helpers beside qcopy() in include/common.h, and the 17 functions that match with them: 54,460 bytes. The report goes from 3,114 to 3,131 of 5,109 functions and from 51.63% to 53.10% of the code.
The helpers

qcopy_nc(dst, src) is qcopy() without the "memory" clobber. Retail has both behaviours: the hero's state-setting function reloads a value after a copy, and the hero's update function keeps it in its register across one.
qzero(p) is sq $0,0(p), a 128-bit zero store. C…
